_comment: Instances whose aggregator.fbo_position cannot be derived from
SUM(signed events) - SUM(captured reserves) — checked by
A RATCHET, in the same sense as schema-parity-baseline.json: shrink it,
never grow it by hand. An entry here is an admission that a live position
has a source outside the model, which is exactly the condition that let
the payment hub's sign error hide. Adding a name silences the only check
that would catch that class of bug for that instance.
Both entries below are synthetic instances created by test fixtures, not
inst_chaos_test: Chaos-drill fixture. Position ($55) is 10x off its archived transfer.settled total ($550) — the drill deliberately injects duplicate and partial deliveries, so the row records fault-injection, not settlement.
inst_saga_test: Origination-saga fixture. Position was seeded directly (last_seq = 0, so the hub never touched it) and then moved by 20 accepted originations; there are no ingested events behind it at all.
